powers.action_summary: Collect and administer the hotel or motel tax using the same means and manner as other town taxes.
powers.quote: Such tax may be collected and administered by the chief fiscal officer of the town of Minisink by such means and in such manner as other taxes which are now collected and administered by such officer or as otherwise may be provided by such local law.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax

powers.action_summary: Provide by local law for the filing of tax returns and payment of the tax on a monthly or other periodic basis.
powers.quote: Such local laws may provide for the filing of returns and the payment of the tax on a monthly basis or on the basis of any longer or shorter period of time.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax

powers.action_summary: Limit each local law enactment imposing the hotel or motel tax to a period of no more than three years.
powers.quote: Each enactment of such local law may provide for the imposition of a hotel or motel tax for a period of time no longer than three years from the effective date of its enactment.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax

powers.action_summary: Adopt and amend a local law or ordinance establishing a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on vehicle owners for red-light violations in the town.
powers.quote: the town of Woodbury is hereby authorized and empowered to adopt and amend a local law or ordinance establishing a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with traffic-control indications in such town in accordance with the provisions of this section.
affected_groups: vehicle owners in the town of Woodbury
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury

powers.action_summary: Install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices at the intersection of State Route 32 and Woodbury Outlets Boulevard North, after obtaining written approval from the department of transportation.
powers.quote: Such demonstration program shall empower such town to install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices at the intersection located at the intersection of state route thirty-two and Woodbury outlets boulevard north, upon approval in writing obtained by such town from the department of transportation
affected_groups: vehicle owners in the town of Woodbury
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury

powers.action_summary: Rescind or modify, at any time, its written approval for the town's installation of traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices.
powers.quote: provided that the department of transportation may at any time rescind or modify such approval.
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury

powers.action_summary: Provide, in the local law or ordinance, an additional penalty of up to twenty-five dollars for failure to respond to a notice of liability within the prescribed time.
powers.quote: such local law or ordinance may provide for an additional penalty not in excess of twenty-five dollars for each violation for the failure to respond to a notice of liability within the prescribed time period.
affected_groups: vehicle owners in the town of Woodbury
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury

powers.action_summary: Adopt and amend a local law or ordinance establishing a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on vehicle owners for traffic-control signal violations and installing monitoring devices at two specified intersections.
powers.quote: the town of Palm Tree is hereby authorized and empowered to adopt and amend a local law or ordinance establishing a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with traffic-control indications in such town in accordance with the provisions of this section.
affected_groups: vehicle owners in the town of Palm Tree
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree

powers.action_summary: Approve in writing, and at any time rescind or modify approval of, the town of Palm Tree's installation of traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices.
powers.quote: upon approval in writing obtained by such town from the department of transportation, provided that the department of transportation may at any time rescind or modify such approval.
powers.law_title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree

powers.action_summary: Discontinue the use of the described parklands and sell and convey them at fair market value to Good Shepherd Communities for a skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility.
powers.quote: to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate the lands described in section three of this act, and to sell and convey such lands at fair market value to Good Shepherd Communities for the purpose of the construction of a skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility.
affected_groups: residents of the village of New Berlin
powers.law_title: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to alienate certain parklands
